references.text: The three hundred men who followed Gideon were chosen earlier in the chapter, and here we see them continuing the pursuit.
Gideon and his men pursued the Midianites and crossed the Jordan, as this text continues to describe.
The pursuit of Zebah and Zalmunna continues, showing the exhaustion of Gideon's men mentioned here.
David's men were also too exhausted to cross the Brook Besor during the pursuit, a similar situation with weary warriors.
Isaiah speaks that even young men grow tired and weary, but those who wait on the Lord will renew their strength.
